decisions.label: unrelated
decisions.rationale: Asks for the meaning of date properties, a different information item from recording publication and modification times to the time of day; only the terms are shared.

decisions.label: partial
decisions.rationale: Same information item (release date) but for a catalogue rather than datasets, and without the time-of-day precision or the multiple-daily-publication condition.

decisions.label: partial
decisions.rationale: Same information item (modification date) but for a catalogue rather than datasets, and without the time-of-day precision or the multiple-daily-publication condition.

decisions.label: partial
decisions.rationale: Lists a dataset's issued and modified dates among other fields but does not ask for the time-of-day precision the atom requires, so neither contains the other.

decisions.label: partial
decisions.rationale: Shares attributes such as unit of measure that qualify observed values but concerns attaching them at dataset level to avoid redundancy, not describing them the same way across formats.
